hook: Andrej Karpathy has spent his career moving between building frontier neural networks and teaching other people how they work. He was a founding research scientist at OpenAI in 2015, then spent five years as Tesla's Director of AI leading the computer vision team behind Autopilot and Full Self-Driving. Along the way he designed and taught CS231n, Stanford's first deep learning course, and built a large public following through blog posts and YouTube lectures that walk through how language models are actually built. After a second stint at OpenAI and a run at his own AI education venture, Eureka Labs, he joined Anthropic's pretraining team in May 2026.

timeline.event: BSc at the University of Toronto, double majoring in computer science and physics with a minor in math
timeline.impact: First exposure to deep learning through Geoffrey Hinton's class and reading groups

timeline.event: MSc at the University of British Columbia, working on machine learning for physically simulated figures
PhD at Stanford under Fei-Fei Li, with internships at Google Brain, Google Research, and DeepMind
timeline.impact: Designs and teaches CS231n, Stanford's first deep learning course
Works on deep learning research at OpenAI from its founding
Leads the computer vision team for Autopilot and Full Self-Driving

timeline.event: Returns to OpenAI to build a team on midtraining and synthetic data generation
timeline.impact: Second stint focused on training methodology

timeline.event: Joins Anthropic's pretraining team in May
timeline.impact: Starts a team focused on using Claude to accelerate pretraining research

quick_facts: Founding research scientist at OpenAI, 2015 to 2017
Director of AI at Tesla, 2017 to 2022, leading the computer vision team for Autopilot and Full Self-Driving
Returned to OpenAI, 2023 to 2024, building a team focused on midtraining and synthetic data generation
PhD from Stanford, 2011 to 2015, advised by Fei-Fei Li, where he designed and taught CS231n, the university's first deep learning course
Founded Eureka Labs, an AI education venture, in 2024
Joined Anthropic's pretraining team in May 2026

achievements.title: Founding research scientist, OpenAI
achievements.impact: Joined OpenAI at its founding in 2015 and worked there as a founding member and research scientist through 2017.

achievements.title: Director of AI, Tesla
achievements.impact: Led the computer vision team behind Tesla Autopilot, and briefly Optimus, overseeing data labeling, neural network training, and deployment on Tesla's custom inference chips from 2017 to 2022.

achievements.title: CS231n, Stanford University
achievements.impact: Designed and served as primary instructor for Stanford's first deep learning course, which grew from 150 students in 2015 to 750 in 2017.

achievements.title: Eureka Labs
achievements.impact: Founded an AI-native education company in 2024 after his second stint at OpenAI.
